en: Tinted historic postcard view of a busy bridge with ornate railings and lampposts, filled with pedestrians in late 19th–early 20th century clothing. The bridge leads into a street lined with multi‑storey buildings and shop signs, dominated by a tall church or tower with a bulbous onion dome and a clock. At the bottom in red Gothic-style script it reads "Graz." on the left and "Erzherzog Ferd. Karl-Brücke." on the right, with a small number "Nr. 537." in the lower left corner.
